end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Identified triangles from three sides and three corners, including tilted shapes.
Identified a rectangle as having four sides and four corners.
Practised tracing/counting sides in a star; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes even when they were turned. Ayaan used counting to identify triangles and correctly explained that a tilted triangle is still a triangle; a brief mix-up about the number of sides was corrected later (turns 9–13). At home, ask Ayaan to find everyday shapes and count their sides and corners aloud.
